## Exact accepted scope

For every integer d >= 2, the unchanged manuscript constructs a full lattice-automorphism-invariant, translation-mixing bond law on Z^d with ordinary **nonuniform finite energy**, almost surely one infinite cluster C, and quenched internal Bernoulli bond thresholds p_c(X)=p_c(C)=1. The internal site-thinning remark is also accepted.

Two independent written AI audits accept the exact frozen proof without correction. Timár's established one-ended factor-of-iid spanning-tree theorem is the external input; Häggström–Mester's summable-flip construction is explicitly credited. No uniform-energy, finitary-coding, positive-association, finite-dependence, novelty, verified-first-solution, human-peer-review, or formal-verification claim is made.

## Contents and provenance

- Unchanged author proof and three-approach record
- Both full independent mathematical audits and separate acceptance reports
- Three immutable ZIPs, external manifests, all 15 regular data members, and public source/dataset verification metadata
- Publication scope, acceptance, static test results, and exact inventory

The author freeze's historical pending-review labels remain unchanged. No proof patch was required. Static identity and safety checks passed in normal and optimized isolated Python, including 21 expected rejection controls per mode; these are not mathematical proof checks. Exact remote readback passed for all 28 files. [The exact-head verification receipt](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/838#issuecomment-6019338039) records archive/member replay, the three-cell queue delta, and the observed CI state.

## Queue

Rank 875 / ID 10000036 changes only Status to `claimed_solved`, Turns to `3/5`, and the qualified Findings cell. All unrelated queue content, notes and chat links are preserved. The branch includes the latest main commit observed during preparation.

Only authorized authored work and public verification metadata are published. No copied source PDFs/text, raw datasets, private coordination, private sources, private personal data, or private checker fingerprints are included. No merge, release, DOI or outreach is part of this draft.

Start with [the proof and scope](https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/blob/ed2de7249953ba0c1afad253adca9b820d7297c5/unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/10000036/README.md).
